summary_text: ARM reported strongest quarter ever - Q4 revenue $1.49B, +20% YoY. Non-GAAP EPS record $0.60 in Q4, $1.77 for fiscal 2026. Data center royalty revenue more than doubled YoY. AGI CPU (first in-house silicon for agentic AI data centers) is newest catalyst. >$2B customer demand across FY27-FY28 (more than 2x at launch); supply gap of ~$1B unmet. License revenue +29% to $819M, royalty +11% to $671M. Next earnings: August 5, 2026.
